comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This interesting and difficult to obtain item requires the following to create it:

Trojan War Soldier's Armour + Orichalcum x1 + Check (10 million㌦) x5 + Special Purchase Bond x5
Rank 12 Alchemy + Casting skills
Completion of the "Egypt & Atlantis" story quest from the Atlantis chain to unlock Transmutation Alchemy.

Stats:

Durability: 60
Defense: 50
Swordplay +2
Sword Mastery +1
Rowing +1
Unisex; 50k fame to equip.
EX Effect: Increase Melee Capabilities R2

Granted, there are better EX melee boost equips in the game. But hey. Now you know.

Note: never having owned or made this item, it's possible that the EX Effect is actually the version that doesn't work in PVP. If so, sorry about the mix-up. Cheers.
